id: 196-克洛狄烏斯·阿爾比努斯篡位未遂

battle.name: 克洛狄烏斯·阿爾比努斯篡位未遂
battle.brief: 公元196年春，駐不列顛的克洛狄烏斯·阿爾比努斯被軍團推舉為帝，率軍渡海入高盧，與塞維魯爭位；次年在隆迪訥姆城外的平原上會戰，阿爾比努斯全軍覆沒並陣亡。卡面的羅馬方陣盾正處退役交替期，盾緣相扣的密集防線仍由高盧與不列顛的舊式軍團延續。

kit.name: 羅馬方陣盾
kit.history: 凸面的長方盾。羅馬的防線靠盾緣咬住盾緣，不是靠盾牌多厚。

countries: 這場衝突是羅馬帝國在「五皇之亂」最後階段的一場內戰，交戰的兩方同屬羅馬帝國的制度框架，並非國與國之間的戰爭。公元193年4月，禁衛軍先後殺死佩蒂納克斯、刺殺尤利亞努斯，隨即公開拍賣皇位；出身潘諾尼亞行省的將軍塞維魯以重金買得帝位，靠多瑙河下游的軍團與禁衛軍的推戴入主，同年4月9日取得元老院的正式承認。阿爾比努斯一方以不列顛與高盧的軍力為骨幹：他自公元191年出任不列顛總督，公元193年至195年之間曾被塞維魯冊封為凱撒，與敘利亞總督佩斯凱尼烏斯·尼格爾同時分封，並據說得到一批元老暗中支持。公元196年，不列顛的軍團第二奧古斯塔、第六勝軍團與第二十瓦萊里亞勝軍團推舉阿爾比努斯為帝，他隨即揮師渡海入高盧，據有高盧行省的主要軍團與城市，等於切斷塞維魯的西翼。塞維魯則握有多瑙河上游的伊利里亞、潘諾尼亞與德意志軍團，以及敘利亞、埃及的援軍與禁衛軍，兵源與補給由地中海兩岸的帝國核心供應。第三方是尚未表明立場的行省與軍團：萊茵河與多瑙河沿岸的軍團先後轉向塞維魯，不列顛以外的西方行省多數選擇服從中央。這場內戰的實質，是帝國在長達數十年的相對安定之後，第一次由帝國自己的軍隊決定皇位的歸屬。
countriesEn: This clash was a civil war fought in the final phase of the Year of the Five Emperors, and both sides fought inside the institutional framework of the Roman Empire rather than as separate states. After the Praetorian Guard had killed Pertinax and then murdered Didius Julianus, it put the imperial office up for public auction. Septimius Severus, a soldier from the province of Pannonia, bought it with a heavy payment, riding to power on the legions of the lower Danube and on the guard, and was formally recognised by the Senate on 9 April 193. Albinus's side rested on the military forces of Britain and of Gaul. He had been governor of Britain from 191, was made Caesar by Severus at some point between 193 and 195 alongside Pescennius Niger the governor of Syria, and is said to have enjoyed the discreet support of a group of senators. In 196 the British legions II Augusta, VI Victrix and XX Valeria Victrix acclaimed Albinus emperor. He immediately carried his troops across the channel into Gaul, took possession of the chief legions and cities of the province of Gaul, and so cut off Severus's western flank. Severus, for his part, held the Illyrian, Pannonian and German legions of the upper Danube together with reinforcements from Syria and Egypt and the Praetorian Guard, drawing his men and his supplies from the imperial core on both shores of the Mediterranean. The third party consisted of the provinces and legions that had not yet declared themselves: the garrisons of the Rhine and the Danube turned to Severus in turn, and most of the western provinces outside Britain chose obedience. The substance of the war was that, after decades of comparative peace, the empire's own soldiers for the first time decided who was to be emperor.
people: 阿爾比努斯是這場衝突的主角。他出身非洲行省的貴族家庭，祖先是馬略時代的軍事統帥，家族在非洲、希臘與高盧都有田產與關係，這份家世在五皇之亂的混亂中被視為他日後受人擁立的資本。他本人在帝國的軍政體系內循級序升遷，先任軍團主管，後任不列顛總督，公元193年由塞維魯推為凱撒。公元196年春，他在不列顛被軍團推上皇位，隨即調度渡海，把不列顩的軍隊帶入高盧；史料稱他曾下令處死一名中央派往不列顛的官員，此舉加深了軍人對他的怨恨。與他對峙的塞維魯則是決定性的一方：他不僅靠禁衛軍拍賣皇位的醜聞取得帝位，更在同時對付尼格爾與阿爾比努斯時展現出策略家的手腕，一再以凱撒頭銜安撫對手，又暗中令各行省總督繳械。他身邊有兄弟普布利烏斯·塞普蒂米烏斯·蓋塔與岳父蓋烏斯·尤利烏斯·阿維圖斯·歐布利基阿努斯，兩人分別於公元197年與198年取得共治地位與奧古斯都的頭銜，鞏固了塞維魯王朝。在戰場上真正扭轉局面的，是阿爾比努斯陣中不列顛與高盧軍團的倒戈，以及塞維魯騎兵對側翼的迂迴打擊。塞維魯在得知阿爾比努斯的死訊之後留下那句「其餘的饒了吧，這是內戰」，把這場同室操戈的殘酷度留在了他自己的記錄裡。
peopleEn: Albinus was the central figure of this conflict. He came from a senatorial family of the African province, descended from a military commander of Marius's day, with estates and connections in Africa, Greece and Gaul, and in the confusion of the Five Emperors that pedigree was treated as the capital on which his future claim would rest. He himself rose through the military and administrative hierarchy of the empire, serving first as a legate and later as governor of Britain, and was made Caesar by Severus in 193. In the spring of 196 the legions in Britain acclaimed him emperor; he immediately shifted them across the channel and carried them into Gaul. The sources record that he ordered the execution of an official sent from the centre to Britain, an act that deepened the resentment of the soldiers. Against him stood Septimius Severus, the decisive party. He had reached the throne through the scandal of the guard's auction of the empire, and he showed the hand of a strategist in dealing with Niger and Albinus at once, twice quieting his rivals with the title of Caesar while quietly ordering provincial governors to disarm. Around him were his brother Publius Septimius Geta and his father-in-law Gaius Julius Avitus Obtusianus, who were to gain co-regency and the title of Augustus in 197 and 198 respectively, consolidating the Severan dynasty. What actually turned the battle was the defection of the British and Gallic legions inside Albinus's line and the strike of Severus's cavalry against the flank. On hearing of Albinus's death, Severus left the words 'let the rest live, for this is a civil war', preserving the brutality of the fratricidal struggle in his own record.
kits: 卡面這面羅馬方陣盾是本役的裝備核心。公元196年前後，羅馬軍團的盾牌正處在一次漫長的形制更替之中：共和末期至帝國前期的矩形大盾（scutum）寬約一公尺、高約一公尺二，重量在十公斤上下，凸面木板外包蒙皮，邊緣加金屬包邊，盾心常有一枚金屬凸紐；這種盾可以左右相扣，排成連續的盾牆，羅馬之所以能頂住蠻族衝撞與標槍齊射，靠的就是盾緣咬住盾緣，而不是盾體本身的厚實。進入公元二世紀後，一部分軍團改用橢圓形大盾，即所謂圖雷奧斯式的方陣盾，輔助軍與輕步兵則普遍使用圓盾與小盾。塞維魯一方特別倚重希臘式裝備部隊：配橢圓大盾、投槍、短矛與銅盔，往往列在軍團方陣之前充當前鋒，專職衝散敵陣；阿爾比努斯一方則以不列顛與高盧的舊式軍團為主，矩形方陣盾、鏈甲、仍可見的條狀甲、投槍（pilum）與短劍（gladius）成套配備。除單兵兵器外，兩軍同樣依賴營地工程：羅馬軍在野外部署時每日挖掘壕溝、堆築土壘，行軍縱隊前出先鋒與兩翼警戒；騎兵多為高盧式與伊利里亞式，攜帶輕便的騎槍，輔助軍弓手則用彎弓在近身距離射擊。
kitsEn: The Roman scutum on the card is the equipment at the centre of this campaign. Around AD 196 the shields of the Roman legions were in the middle of a long change of shape. The tall rectangular scutum of the late Republic and early Empire, roughly one metre wide and 1.2 metres high and about ten kilograms in weight, was a convex wooden board faced with hide and edged with metal, often carrying a metal boss at the centre. Such a shield could be locked edge to edge to form a continuous wall, and the reason Rome could absorb the charge of the barbarians and the massed pila was that shield met shield, not that the shield itself was thick. In the second century part of the legions took up the tall oval shield, the scutum of the thureos type, while auxiliaries and light infantry came to rely on the round parma and the small caetra. Severus relied in particular on troops equipped in the Greek manner, men with oval shields, javelins, short spears and bronze helmets, often drawn up in front of the legionary squares as a spearhead whose task was to break the enemy order. Albinus's army, by contrast, rested on the old legions of Britain and Gaul, equipped in sets with the rectangular shield, the mail shirt, the segmentata still seen on some men, the pilum and the gladius. Beyond the individual arms, both armies depended equally on field fortification: the Roman excavates a trench and raises an earthwork each day it stands in the field, and the columns move with a vanguard ahead and outposts on the flanks. The cavalry were largely of Gallic and Illyrian type and carried light lances, while the auxiliary archers shot with composite bows at close range.
tactics: 阿爾比努斯的戰術起點是速度。他得知塞維魯在東方擊敗尼格爾、自己又被控有異志的消息後，搶在塞維魯之前把不列顛的軍隊運過英吉利海峽，選擇在萊姆灣一帶登陸，再沿高盧境內的主要軍用道路北上，避開塞維魯可能的攔截，以高盧的城市與軍團作為補給基地。決戰在隆迪訥姆城外的平原上展開。阿爾比努斯據守的位置有地形可恃，他沒有把全軍鋪成單薄的橫線，而是以正面寬厚的步兵陣列配合兩翼騎兵，構成一個可以互相支援的整體；方陣盾層層相扣，前排的盾手承受對方的第一步衝擊，第二排的投槍手隨即越過己方前排的頭頂投擲，羅馬的老規矩是投槍造成傷亡後立即退回己方盾後整理，換裝短矛再戰。塞維魯的應對是以密集步兵正面黏住對手，同時集中伊利里亞與高盧騎兵迂迴側翼。真正的破壞出現在陣內：阿爾比努斯的步兵在僵持中耗盡了體力與投射兵器，陣中出現騷動與倒戈，騎兵與步兵之間的協同脫節，側翼一旦被突破，整條正面便連鎖崩解。塞維魯隨即下令停止大規模追擊，顯示他判斷這場戰爭的勝負不在殲滅而在士氣與忠誠。
tacticsEn: Albinus's tactical starting point was speed. Once he learned that Severus had beaten Niger in the east and that he himself was suspected of disloyalty, he moved ahead of Severus and ferried the British army across the English Channel, landing around Lymne and driving north along the main military roads of Gaul so as to avoid interception, taking the cities and the legions of the province as his supply base. The decisive action was fought on the plain outside Lugdunum. Albinus held ground that offered natural advantages: rather than stretching the whole army into a single thin line, he formed a broad infantry front with cavalry on the wings, a whole in which each part could support the others. Shield locked to shield, the front rank absorbed the first impact and the second rank threw its pila over the heads of the men in front, and by the old Roman custom the pila line fell back behind its own shields to reform, to take up the short spear and fight again. Severus's answer was to pin the enemy with dense infantry head-on while concentrating Illyrian and Gallic cavalry for a sweep of the flank. The real destruction happened inside the line: Albinus's infantry had exhausted its strength and its missiles in the stalemate, muttering and defection appeared in the ranks, the coordination between cavalry and foot came apart, and once the flank was turned the entire front unravelled in a chain. Severus then called off the mass pursuit, a sign that he judged the war to be decided by morale and loyalty rather than by annihilation.
data: 本役可用的可靠數字極少，以下只列能追溯的量級。第一，帝國全境在公元二世紀末約有三十三個軍團，每團滿編約五千人，加上輔助軍與騎兵，常備軍總規模在數十萬量級，這是理解五皇之亂動因的基本框架：不列顛境內的三個軍團約一萬五千人，加上高盧軍團與輔助部隊，阿爾比努斯可調用的兵力在兩萬上下；塞維魯從意大利、多瑙河與敘利亞方向匯聚的兵力亦在同一量級，雙方總投入當在數萬人之數。第二，距離：從不列顛的萊姆灣登陸點到高盧的要塞海港，例如博洛涅的蓋索里亞庫姆，航程約三百公里，需數日；自蓋索里亞庫姆沿大道南下至隆迪訥姆，路程約八百公里，羅馬軍標準行程每日約三十羅里、折合約四十四公里，故步兵行軍約需二十日，騎兵與傳令兵可先期抵達。第三，時間：從公元196年阿爾比努斯受推舉到次年決戰，前後約一年。第四，決戰本身只打了一天，但傷亡極重，具體數字無從考信，後世記載常寫數萬人之類的概數，難以核實。第五，城市與人口：高盧是帝國最富庶的行省之一，隆迪訥姆是行省首府與羅恩河、索恩河運輸走廊的樞紐，城內人口在數萬量級；全高盧的人口在學界估算中達數百萬至一千萬以上，羅馬時期的兩河沿岸已有密集的道路網與穩定的穀物、葡萄酒供應，這正是兩軍都能在高盧長期作戰的前提。
dataEn: Few reliable numbers survive for this campaign, so only traceable magnitudes are set down here. First, the empire as a whole had some thirty-three legions in the late second century, each about five thousand strong at establishment, and with auxiliaries and cavalry the standing army of the empire ran to hundreds of thousands; that is the basic frame for understanding the Five Emperors. The three legions in Britain numbered around fifteen thousand, and with the Gallic legions and auxiliaries the force Albinus could call on was on the order of twenty thousand, while the troops Severus gathered from Italy, the Danube and Syria were of the same order, so that the total committed on both sides fell in the tens of thousands. Second, distance: the sea crossing from the landing point at Lymne in Britain to the fortified ports of Gaul, such as Gesoriacum, is about three hundred kilometres and takes several days; from Gesoriacum down the great road to Lugdunum is some eight hundred kilometres, and the Roman standard march of about thirty Roman miles, roughly forty-four kilometres, a day puts the infantry at around twenty days on the road, with cavalry and messengers arriving ahead of them. Third, time: from Albinus's acclamation in 196 to the decisive battle in the following year is about a year. Fourth, the decision itself lasted a single day, but the losses were heavy; the exact figures cannot be checked, and later accounts give round numbers such as tens of thousands that resist verification. Fifth, cities and population: Gaul was one of the richest provinces of the empire, Lugdunum was the provincial capital and the transshipment hub of the Rhone-Saone corridor, its population ran into the tens of thousands, and the population of Gaul as a whole is put by scholars in the millions, up to over ten million. By Roman times the valleys of the two rivers already carried a dense road network with regular supplies of grain and wine, which is what made it possible for both armies to fight a campaign in Gaul at all.
cause: 起因而來自公元193年塞維魯奪位的方式。禁衛軍在殺死佩蒂納克斯、刺殺尤利亞努斯之後，把皇位公開拍賣，塞維魯以重金買得帝位，又以自己是拍賣帝國的人自嘲——這段羞辱使元老院、意大利城市與各行省總督普遍不信任他。塞維魯要鞏固帝位，就必須消滅所有握兵權的競爭者：公元193年至195年之間，他同時冊立佩斯凱尼烏斯·尼格爾與阿爾比努斯為凱撒，把帝國分為三塊，這在形式上是妥協，在實質上是把兩位行省總督的軍權變成可以隨時收回的臨時授權。公元195年前後，塞維魯先要求尼格爾交出軍隊，敘利亞的軍團拒絕；接著他把自己的兩個兒子相繼立為凱撒，等於宣告阿爾比努斯與尼格爾的凱撒頭銜即將到期。阿爾比努斯的不列顛軍團這時已不信任塞維魯的中央軍令，而阿爾比努斯在帝國西部的聲望遠高於尼格爾，於是在公元196年二月或三月間，不列顛的軍團推舉他為帝，他宣稱自己是為科莫圖斯復仇、並要維護元老院的自由，隨即把軍隊帶過海。塞維魯聞訊後不與他正面交涉，先以封授與誘降分化對方陣營，又讓各行省總督繳械，再調集多瑙河與敘利亞的軍隊自東向西壓迫，終於迫使高盧的決戰爆發。
causeEn: The cause lay in the manner in which Severus had seized the throne in 193. After the guard had killed Pertinax and murdered Julianus, it put the imperial office up for public auction; Severus bought it with a heavy payment and joked that he was the man who had auctioned the empire. That humiliation left the Senate, the Italian cities and the provincial governors distrusting him across the board. To consolidate his position, Severus had to destroy every rival who commanded troops. Between 193 and 195 he made Pescennius Niger and Albinus Caesars at the same time, dividing the empire in three: in form a compromise, in substance a conversion of the military commands of two provincial governors into temporary grants that could be revoked at will. Around 195 Severus first demanded that Niger hand over his army, and the Syrian legions refused; he then raised his own two sons in turn to the rank of Caesar, which announced that the Caesarships of Albinus and Niger were about to expire. The legions of Britain by then no longer trusted the central military commands of Severus, and Albinus's standing in the western empire was far greater than Niger's, so between February and March 196 the British legions acclaimed him emperor. He proclaimed that he was avenging Commodus and defending the freedom of the Senate, and carried his army across the sea. On hearing of this, Severus did not engage him directly, but used appointments and inducements to split the opposing camp and to alienate part of it, and then concentrated the legions of the Danube and of Syria so as to press westward, until the decision in Gaul could no longer be avoided.
impact: 這場內戰的直接後果是帝國權力的重新集中。塞維魯在戰後成為唯一的奧古斯都，得以在公元197年之後把兒子卡拉卡拉與蓋塔相繼升為凱撒與奧古斯都，並在公元208年大舉入侵不列顛、在公元211年升卡拉卡拉為共治的皇帝，同時為第一次對帕提亞的遠征（約公元197至199年間）以及其後由卡拉卡拉主持的第二次遠征籌措兵員與軍費。元老院被要求正式譴責阿爾比努斯、褫奪其名譽，他的名字從此成為咒詛之辭；支持過他的將領與行省官員被流放到帝國邊疆，阿爾比努斯留下的軍隊則被拆散、整編並調往下多瑙河與東方前線，承擔懲罰性駐防的任務。軍隊層面的後果更為深遠：這場戰爭證明了羅馬皇帝可以由軍團在戰場上指定，元老院與城市毫無實力阻止，此後一個世紀裡禁衛軍廢立皇帝、軍人僭越的事件層出不窮，公元193至197年的連環內戰常被視為三世紀軍人皇帝時代的起點。裝備史上的收穫同樣具體：阿爾比努斯的軍隊是矩形大盾最後一批大規模的使用者，戰後羅馬軍團的盾牌迅速定型為橢圓形大盾與輔助軍圓盾，盾緣相扣的傳統方陣防線自此慢慢退出主力步兵的裝備序列。
impactEn: The immediate effect of the civil war was a reconcentration of power in the empire. Severus emerged as the sole Augustus and was able, after 197, to raise his sons Caracalla and Geta in turn to the ranks of Caesar and Augustus, to invade Britain in 208, to elevate Caracalla to co-regency in 211, and to raise the men and the money for his Parthian war of 197-199 and for the second Parthian war led later by Caracalla. The Senate was required to condemn Albinus formally and strip him of his honour, and his name became a term of abuse; the generals and provincial officials who had supported him were exiled to the frontier, and the army he left behind was broken up, reorganised and sent to the lower Danube and the eastern front as a penal garrison. The military consequences went deeper still: the war proved that a Roman emperor could be designated on the field by the soldiers, with neither the Senate nor the cities able to prevent it, and in the century that followed the making and unmaking of emperors by the Praetorian Guard and the military usurpations multiplied. The successive civil wars of 193-197 are often treated as the beginning of the third-century age of soldier-emperors. The outcome in the history of equipment is equally concrete: Albinus's army was among the last to use the tall rectangular scutum on any large scale, and after the war the Roman legionary shield quickly settled into the tall oval with the round shield of the auxiliaries, so that the tradition of the interlocking shield wall slowly left the equipment list of the line infantry.
result: 決戰的結果是阿爾比努斯的徹底覆滅。他本人在隆迪訥姆城外的平原上兵敗，據《歷史皇帝傳》的記載，他騎的馬在亂軍中跌倒，他被部下或追兵殺死，頭顱被送到塞維魯面前；塞維魯看過之後只說了一句「其餘的饒了吧，這是內戰」，隨即下令停止大規模追殺。塞維魯的軍隊佔領高盧主要城市，元老院隨即正式承認他的獨尊地位，五皇之亂告終。阿爾比努斯的財產被沒收，家族與黨羽遭到清算，他的軍隊被拆散、整編並調往帝國邊疆，同時他的名字在錢幣與銘文上被刻意抹去，羅馬的官方記載裡幾乎找不到他的痕跡，只有少數敵對的史料為他留下記錄。塞維魯由此取得對軍隊的實際控制權，並得以進行大規模擴軍：公元二世紀末至三世紀初，羅馬軍團數量增加到三十三個以上，為此後的東方戰爭與北方戰役儲備兵員。他沒有獎賞幫他奪位的舊部，反而把阿爾比努斯的支持者貶謫到最偏遠的邊防，這一做法成為此後羅馬皇帝處置內戰舊部的慣例。
resultEn: The outcome at Lugdunum was the total destruction of Albinus. He was defeated on the plain outside the city, and according to the Historia Augusta his horse fell in the confusion and he was killed by his own men or by his pursuers, his head being carried to Severus. Severus looked at it and said only, 'let the rest live, for this is a civil war', and then called off the mass killing and the pursuit. Severus's troops occupied the chief cities of Gaul, the Senate promptly acknowledged his sole rule, and the Year of the Five Emperors was over. Albinus's property was confiscated, his family and followers were purged, his army was broken up and reassigned to the frontier, and his name was deliberately erased from coin and inscription, so that the official Roman record preserves almost no trace of him and only a few hostile sources keep a memory of him. Severus thus gained effective control of the armies and was able to expand them: between the late second and the early third century the number of Roman legions rose to more than thirty-three, building up the manpower for the eastern and northern wars that followed. He did not reward those who had helped him to the throne; he exiled Albinus's partisans to the most remote stations, and that practice became the Roman convention for dealing with the survivors of civil war.
